requirements.text: 3+ years of professional experience in machine learning or software engineering, excluding internships and academic research, with hands-on responsibility for deploying and improving production ML models

You must have personally trained or fine-tuned NLP extraction models, deployed them into production, and improved them through error analysis and retraining. Experience limited to LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG/search pipelines or ML infrastructure will not meet this role’s requirements.
Strong Python software engineering skills, including building and maintaining production systems, model inference services and data pipelines
Experience analyzing false positives and false negatives, improving training datasets or labels, and retraining models to deliver measurable improvements against precision and recall requirements
Experience investigating model failures on new or unfamiliar data and making targeted improvements to address them

Hands-on engineering experience at at least one startup, shipping and maintaining a product used by customers or business users, alongside a strong engineering track record and clear career progression
Hands-on experience deploying or operating production software or ML workloads on AWS
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to choose between rules, classical ML, fine-tuned models and LLM-based approaches using evaluation results
Brooklyn, New York, NY. In-office, five days per week. Relocation bonus of up to $10,000 available.
A strong academic background in a relevant STEM discipline is preferred, particularly a degree from a highly ranked university; relevant PhDs completed or nearing completion are also welcomed

Machine Learning Engineer / Applied Machine Learning Engineer / NLP Engineer / Production ML Engineer / ML Software Engineer / Python Software Engineer / NLP Software Engineer / Applied Scientist / Python / PyTorch / Transformers / Named Entity Recognition / Entity Resolution / Sensitive Data Detection / Structured Information Extraction / GLiNER / ONNX Runtime / TensorRT / AWS / Active Learning / Transformer Fine-Tuning / Data Pipelines / Model Evaluation / Precision / Recall / Model Retraining / Multimodal Models / Data De-identification / Computer Science / Mathematics / Statistics / Engineering / Physics
